title: Su Ru storms Tongtian Peak
summary: The Ghost King hears of Bai Hu's death, and Gui Li is dismissed as a mere boy: in forty-nine days the Dragon-Subduing Cauldron will finish gathering the four spirits and give him the power of the Ming King. The two surviving Saint Beast envoys mourn their fallen brothers and cling to the hope that Bi Yao may still wake. Gui Li kneels at his parents' graves in Grass Temple Village and promises he will not stand by this time. On Small Bamboo Peak, Lu Xueqi has shut herself away since coming home. She tells Wen Min she does not want an immortality without love, and is content to keep one person in her heart knowing she is in his. When Tian Buyi does not come back from Tongtian Peak, Su Ru unseals her sword Moxue and storms the Yuqing Hall, facing down Elders Fan and Yang and Xiao Yicai until Shui Yue arrives. They find the Ancestral Hall wrecked and Lin Jingyu badly hurt but alive, and both Dao Xuan and Tian Buyi gone. Xiao Yicai orders a quiet search, and Su Ru leaves to find her husband herself. Meanwhile Zhou Yixian leads Xiao Huan and Ye Gou Daoren into an old hall of repose, where a man in Qingyun robes vows that anyone who opposes him must die. He is unimpressed by their ghost-moving spell and says such tricks will not save the three of them.
